SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE bracelet only, lying on the top face in a relaxed oval, the clasp at the back, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; it lies diagonally on a small cream cushion held in a hand, with a gold cuff, a pear ring and other bracelets: take ONLY the line of small heart stones; ignore the cushion, the hand, the cuff, the ring and the velvet. IMAGE 2 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A HEART TENNIS BRACELET: one continuous line of small clear HEART-shaped faceted stones, each in its own thin polished gold bezel, linked edge to edge, every heart pointing the same way along the line; a small gold box clasp. Every stone is a clear heart in a gold bezel, never round, never pear; one single line, never two rows; no charms, no chain between the hearts.

SCALE TEST: Each heart is about 5mm across, the size of a peppercorn; the line is about 5mm wide and about 17cm long. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.
